caption: The video captures a steady, elevated view of a charred field where active burning is already underway. In the lower-center foreground, a roughly oval patch of debris burns with bright yellow-orange flames. Individual flame tongues rise, shrink, and tilt from frame to frame, while the oval fire footprint remains fixed. Thin grey-white smoke lifts from the burning pile and drifts gently toward the right side of the smoky scene. In the upper-left background, a separate line of fire smolders among blackened ground, scattered debris, and sparse trees. Small flames flicker along this distant line, and additional smoke plumes join the hazy air above the burned field. Several leafless trees stand unmoving through the drifting smoke, and scorched earth surrounds the active fires. The framing stays largely consistent across the clip.
relations: Foreground oval debris sustains bright flames that flicker and tilt while its footprint stays fixed on scorched ground.
Thin smoke rising from the burning pile drifts gently toward the right across the hazy field.
Distant background line of fire smolders among blackened ground, producing additional smoke plumes that join the haze.
Leafless trees remain unmoving through drifting smoke while active fires continue burning.
